meta.title: Compression tiers & toolbox
meta.description: Five-tier context compression plus global and workspace rules editing, managed downloads for four components and per-session repository publishing. Tiers switch from the Compression tiers panel in the sidebar and apply to every preset engine at once, no restart, with automatic pressure compaction kept on each tier; the same panel edits the global AGENTS.md and the AGENTS.md of each registered workspace; components are detected on PATH or downloaded there (GitHub CLI, git, ffmpeg/ffprobe, Python — resumable, rollback on failure, managed copy first on PATH); the repository pill above the input decides where github_push publishes. Tools: compression_tiers, compression_context, compression_compact, github_push. It downloads those components from GitHub releases, gyan.dev and python-build-standalone; with the plugin off, tiers stop syncing, managed directories leave PATH, and the tools and panel disappear. Limits: tiers assume 256k-token windows or more, and only preset-isolated engines are updated.
